ruleDefinitions.name: New Service Creation Using Sc.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a new service using the "sc.exe" utility.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*create.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*binPath.*"))) AND  NOT (((parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Dropbox\\\\Client\\\\") OR parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Dropbox\\\\Client\\\\")) AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Dropbox\\\.exe$")))
